lines: I made it back with one bandage left and none to spare.
My hands shook after the fighting stopped.
I kept moving until the village gate was behind me.
A potion bought me the few seconds I needed.
I returned bruised, frightened, and alive.
The last enemy fell before my strength did.
I heard the bell from the road and followed it home.
My shield broke, so I used the terrain instead.
I treated the worst cut before starting back.
The fight was short. The walk home felt endless.
I remembered to breathe only after I was safe.
One clean escape mattered more than winning another exchange.
I left supplies behind rather than risk going back for them.
The armor held where it needed to.
I am alive because I knew when to retreat.
Someone covered me while I drank the remedy.
The wound looks ugly, but it is clean.
I counted every familiar roof as I approached.
There will be no heroics in my version of that story.
I survived. Let me sit down before I explain how.
